name: Vet CBD | 300mg Dog Treats 60ct | Mobility Peanut Butter
description: Support your dog’s movement, comfort, and overall vitality with VetCBD Mobility Soft Chews—veterinarian-formulated for daily joint and hip support. Each soft chew delivers a targeted blend of 5mg Broad Spectrum CBD, 20mg Boswellia Extract, and 5mg Black Pepper Extract, working together to promote flexibility, ease stiffness, and support healthy inflammatory responses in active, aging, or mobility-challenged dogs. Whether your pup is slowing down, bouncing back from activity, or needs long-term joint care, these tasty chews offer a convenient, mess-free way to help them move through life comfortably.
